Name: Hisame furniture - Toothless dragon statue replace bear
Author: hisameartwork
Description:
With content patcher: ad it to mod folder.
Without: just replaces the bear with Tootles the dragon from the How to train your dragon movie adaptation. More furniture coming soon. I'm just waiting for beta to finish.

Install w/o CP:
- Unzip file. Use archive program to unzip (winrar or 7zip).
- Place file in Stardew Valley > Content > TileSheets


[b]NEW DGA compatibility is available[/b], curtesy of: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/53724786]F﻿rench Dodo[/url]! Now Toothless will no longer replace the bear, but be available as purchase in Robin's shop! 


***Toothless png is available to use for other projects. Have fun, love Tootless, feed him fish!
